static_traits.name: Wang Hai
static_traits.social_status: Social interaction is limited, only interacting with a few casual acquaintances at bars, lacking intimate relationships with whom deep emotions can be shared
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;既往not yet接受过心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,逻辑性较好,能自我Reflection,Positive attitude配合;谈及家庭与节日话题时情绪基调偏Anxiety与愤怒

basic_info.main_problem: 想到即将到来的假期,由于have not很多愿意相处的家人而感到overwhelmed与Anxiety,进一步出现愤怒和Loneliness;这些感受在Divorce后近年加重,导致回避Social gatherings并在节日前持续产生惧怕与Repression.
basic_info.core_demands: 因为即将到来的假期引发强烈情绪,希望Learning更好地应对愤怒与Loneliness感.
growth_experiences: 童年时期的节日经历常伴随父母争吵,家庭气氛紧张,使'节日=not愉快/冲突'的记忆被Reinforcement,对成年后的节日体验产生负面影响.
成年后Divorce带来显著的Loneliness感与失落,节日成为放大Loneliness与被疏离感的时段;与部分家人Relationship tension,感觉被评判与not被理解,进一步加重对节日的负面Anticipation与回避.

core_beliefs: 我not会被家人真正理解与接纳
节日对我来说注定是Loneliness与痛苦的

special_situations.event: 临近假期,Anticipation将与家人聚会
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I spend time with family, they will judge me and embarrass me, and gatherings will only become negative experiences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids holiday gatherings in advance, reducing contact to reduce chances of being hurt
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will definitely criticize me; this gathering will be terrible

special_situations.event: Recalls memories of parents arguing and a tense atmosphere during past holidays
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the holidays are like the past, they will only repeat pain and conflict
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过去酒吧分散注意,观看他人以逃避not适情绪
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 节日一到只会更难受,have not任何乐趣

special_situations.event: Interacting with some family members or thinking about upcoming interaction
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们not理解或评判我,说明我not受欢迎,与他们相处只能更糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pre-assuming negative evaluation, closing oneself off and avoiding contact
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们就是看not起我,会批评我

special_situations.event: 意识到自己'have not很多喜欢相处的家人'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not足够喜欢的家人,整个节日就注定失败与痛苦
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Characterizes the holiday overall as bad, gives up trying other possible ways to spend it
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这个假期一定会很惨,have not任何值得期待的地方

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted, understood, and to gain intimate connection and a sense of belonging during holidays
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, rejected, and humiliated by family, experiencing conflict and isolation again
defense_goal: Avoids being judged and hurt by keeping distance and avoiding gatherings
Uses distraction to lessen the intensity of painful emotions

object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻,批判且not理解自己的家庭成员

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about or being invited to family holiday gatherings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将家人体验为批判者,Anticipation自己会被挑剔,羞辱(移情:将早年'被指责/冲突'的模板Projection到当前家庭互动中)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以务实,冷静的语气强调客观理由(身体not适,行程not便)来推拒邀约,避免情感讨论.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When exploring painful memories or strong emotions related to holidays in the session
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates emotional expression with vulnerability, worrying about being judged or losing control after exposure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以简短,事实化描述替代感受词,快速Displacement到事件细节或策略层面的讨论.

manifestations: Divorce后节日期间的Loneliness与疏离被放大
Strained relationships with family members,感觉被评判与not被理解
回避Social gatherings,难以与他人建立亲近联系
outcomes: Intense dread of and avoidance before holidays

manifestations: Hard to experience joy and meaning in the holiday atmosphere
Views the holiday period as a whole as a 'painful / failure' period

positive_force: Willing to seek help and try new methods (such as recording and restructuring thoughts)
Able to be aware of and name their own automatic thoughts and patterns (admitting that they may 'jump to conclusions')
Maintains a positive attitude toward counseling, willing to cooperate with homework
Has certain social contact channels (communicating with casual acquaintances in bars) and basic resources for external contact
negative_force: Long-term negative cognitive patterns such as catastrophizing, jumping to conclusions, and mind reading
Strained relationships with family members,被评判与not被理解的内在关系模板
Social avoidance与情绪闭合,use分散注意替代情感接触
Conditioned fear before holidays and bodily / sleep rhythms affected
Absence of intimate relationships; the deep emotional support system is weak

antecedent: 临近假期,Anticipation将与家人相处
Recalls memories of past holiday conflicts and being judged
Automatic thought: they will criticize me; the gathering will be terrible
target_behavior.core_reason: 基于早年节日冲突与Divorce后Loneliness的体验,形成'会被评判/not被接纳'的核心信念与灾难化Anticipation,因而通过回避来降低Anxiety与潜在羞辱感
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪与潜在的负面评价(负Reinforcement)
target_behavior.consequence: 短期减轻Anxiety,但加剧Loneliness与抑郁化情绪,维持负性信念,进一步削弱社交与睡眠质量

target_behavior.behavior: Copes with holiday-related emotions through distraction such as going to bars to 'people-watch'
antecedent: 想到节日或与家人互动引发的Anxiety与愤怒
target_behavior.core_reason: To avoid contact with painful emotions and relationship conflict, seeks substitute behaviors that distract attention in the short term
target_behavior.function: 获得短期情绪缓解与注意力Displacement
target_behavior.consequence: not yet能触及与修正核心信念与关系模式,潜在维持问题循环
